technical.summary: Early-stage momentum signals (MACD/StochRSI crossovers, OBV rising) show potential but lack directional conviction; price remains below 200-SMA and intermediate trend is weak, limiting swing entry confidence.

fundamental.summary: CPT shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying spend, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 51 days create near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; fear sentiment (39) presents contrarian opportunity, but lack of senior/large-amount buying and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession, VIX at crisis levels (233.28), CPI event imminent, and real estate sector faces credit stress in tightening environment; 51-day earnings adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Early MACD/StochRSI crossovers with rising OBV suggest nascent momentum reversal in a fear-zone environment where contrarian positioning could reward early entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely hostile (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, credit stress), price remains below 200-SMA and 50-SMA with no directional conviction (ADX false, Hull false), and zero fundamental/insider support creates unacceptable risk-reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Early MACD/StochRSI crossovers with rising OBV suggest nascent momentum in a fear-zone environment, but conviction is severely undermined by macro headwinds and lack of directional strength confirmation.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and credit spread stress create hostile macro backdrop for real estate sector entry; price below 200-SMA with no ADX/Hull confirmation limits swing trade viability.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Zero existing Real Estate exposure and no CPT position; macro environment severity and earnings proximity (51 days) warrant avoidance despite low sector concentration risk.
